Tether by Spacie — attended remote terminal debugging for developers and AI agents.

This release contains Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon/Intel, and Linux x64 installers, plus SHA-256 checksums. Every artifact is built from this tag after the shared cross-platform checks pass and its native MCP executable is tested.

Updater packages are signed and verified by Tether. Windows publisher signing and Apple notarization are not configured; installers may show publisher or Gatekeeper prompts. Linux in-app updates require the AppImage build.

Version-specific changes are documented under `docs/releases/<version>.md` when available. Check for updates in Settings and choose when to install. Approved shells inherit the host account's permissions; the starting folder is not a sandbox. Cloudflare terminates TLS. Screen sharing and unattended access are outside this release.

See the repository README for setup and `docs/MCP.md` for agent configuration and the copy-paste prompt.
